validation_target: original metal-blade steady hover rotor performance
required_program_fields: env.rho; rotor.R; rotor.Nb; rotor.rootCut; rotor.Omega; rotor.chord; rotor.twistTip; rotor.liftSlope; rotor.CLmax; rotor.CD0; rotor.kCD; rotor.Ib; rotor.Sblade; rotorCtrl.collective; numerical rotor grid/solver fields
explicitly_not_required: wing/fuselage/tails; aircraft I0/KI; control-surface limits; full nacelle-angle RPM schedule
parameter_mapping_rule: direct test conditions for rho/Omega; direct configuration for R/Nb/rootCut; equivalent reduction for chord/twist; input adapter for theta75 collective; reconstruct low-order section aero; keep Ib/Sblade physically coupled
calibration_rule: section-aero or other effective calibration may use only independent data; freeze V1 parameter pack before TM-86833 hold-out comparison
upgrade_gate: upgrade constant-chord/linear-twist/model-form only if equivalent-reduction error or sensitivity demonstrates dominant unacceptable validation error

required_program_fields: all relevant V1 rotor fields; cyclic input adapter; betaM convention; pivot/RH_hub when local velocity matters; wing geometry/interaction-model fields needed by selected dataset
explicitly_not_required: whole-aircraft inertia unless target includes rigid-body response; unrelated tail/control-surface parameters
parameter_mapping_rule: preserve V1 frozen rotor pack; add only dataset-required geometry/interference quantities; treat slipstream/blend coefficients as model-form/effective parameters, not aircraft handbook parameters
calibration_rule: interference calibration must use data separate from final forward-flight/interaction validation cases
upgrade_gate: upgrade inflow/interference architecture only after residual structure or sensitivity shows current low-order closure is inadequate

validation_target: whole-aircraft trim and static aerodynamic behavior
required_program_fields: mass/CG; relevant nacelle configuration; test-point RPM; wing/fuselage/tail geometry; reduced static aero coefficients; control definitions and active limits; V1/V2 frozen lower-level packs
explicitly_not_required: dynamic inertia/rate derivatives when only static trim is evaluated; unrelated numerical provenance
parameter_mapping_rule: reduce public GTRS/wind-tunnel multidimensional data to the scalar/polynomial forms actually consumed by current code; direct geometry only when normalization/definition matches
calibration_rule: any trim/static calibration uses designated calibration points and cannot be reused as independent validation evidence
upgrade_gate: upgrade to multidimensional lookup tables only if declared low-order reduction cannot represent required static data within accepted error/structure criteria

required_program_fields: matched mass/CG/inertia; static aero pack; rate derivatives; control-effectiveness and actuator definitions; exact speed/configuration/RPM; linearization numerical convergence
parameter_mapping_rule: use configuration-matched flight-test definitions; distinguish reconstructed component derivatives from identified effective terms; preserve frozen lower-stage parameters unless an explicit re-identification experiment is declared
calibration_rule: flight-ID hold-out cases must be separated from any data used to identify rate derivatives/control effectiveness/actuator parameters
upgrade_gate: upgrade dynamic/actuator model only when mismatch is attributable to omitted dynamics rather than parameter-definition or operating-point mismatch
